def transform(grid):
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    def cw(a): return [list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])]
    def ccw(a): return [list(row) for row in zip(*a)][::-1]
    def rot180(a): return [row[::-1] for row in a[::-1]]
    tiles = [grid, cw(grid), ccw(grid), rot180(grid)]
    out = []
    for top, bottom in zip(tiles[0], tiles[2]):
        out.append(top + tiles[1][len(out)])
    for i in range(n):
        out.append(tiles[2][i] + tiles[3][i])
    return out
